name: Kenji Tanaka
bio: Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. A childhood fascination with engineering led him to study technical security systems, but it was the adrenaline-fueled atmosphere of a local drift racing event that ignited his passion for motorsport. He transitioned from designing security protocols for commercial properties to applying his expertise to the high-stakes world of racing. Kenji's approach is meticulous and preventative, focusing on identifying potential vulnerabilities before they can be exploited. His unwavering commitment to safety and proactive problem-solving distinguishes him in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, high-powered flashlight.
Meticulously organizes his workspace, often rearranging items for optimal efficiency.
Insists on personally testing all security systems, regardless of previous certifications.
